bonus.q: Hvad er grænsen mellem ny farve og spring i ny farve?

options: Ny farve 12–18 ikke krav, spring 19+ udgangskrav

bonus.why: With 12–18 and 5-4, the new suit is bid without a jump – natural and non-forcing (provisional – to be confirmed); with 19+ you jump. Only the jump is game forcing.
